name: 02332 · Duxbury, MA
findings: ZIP 02332 (Duxbury) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02332 (Duxbury) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02332 (Duxbury) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
